AltitudeKind.description: Altitudes keep their meaning: height above take-off is not sea-level or ellipsoidal.
AltitudeKind.title: AltitudeKind

ArtifactCreate.description: Declared before upload; bytes are verified against `byte_size` and the checksum.

final.description: False for previews that a later revision may supersede.

ArtifactCreate.title: ArtifactCreate

uploaded.description: True when the bytes were already received (retry).

revision.description: Monotonic per (job, kind); stale revisions are ignored.

AuthState.description: `setup_required` is true only while no operator account exists.
AuthState.title: AuthState

ComputeTarget.description:
Where a job's GPU work runs. Each worker declares its location and only leases jobs
aimed at it (the API never moves a job between locations on its own).
ComputeTarget.title: ComputeTarget

axes.default: right-handed; +X right, +Y up, -Z forward (OpenGL camera convention)

metres_per_unit.description: Metres per coordinate unit when scale comes from a sensor alignment while coordinates stay in the local frame; null when scale is unknown or units are metres.

units.description: Linear units of coordinates, e.g. 'metre' or 'unitless'.

FrameSeries.description:
Per-frame metrics, column-oriented (one entry per decoded frame, in display order).

- `t`: presentation time in seconds from the stream's first frame.
- `sharpness`: variance of the Laplacian at analysis resolution (higher = sharper).
- `brightness`: mean luma, 0-1.
- `change`: mean absolute luma difference to the previous frame, 0-1.
- `motion_px`: estimated global image shift to the previous frame, in analysis pixels.
- `flags`: per-frame quality flags.
FrameSeries.title: FrameSeries

GeometryBackend.description: What a worker's standard pipeline would use for geometry right now.
GeometryBackend.title: GeometryBackend

Job.description: Current snapshot of a job, rebuilt from its event log.

compute.description: Which worker location runs this job.

estimate.description: The worker's time forecast, once it has leased the job.

last_seq.description: Cursor of the newest event; resume after it.

sampling.description: Frames used (standard pipeline); None for the test pipeline.

Job.title: Job

JobEstimateData.description:
The worker's forecast of how long each stage will take, sent once the job is leased.
Clients combine it with the stages' real progress to show the time remaining.

basis.description: Where the numbers come from, in words (shown to the user).

frames.description: Frames the estimate was made for.

stages.description: Estimated seconds per stage; 0 for a stage already known to be skipped.

JobEstimateData.title: JobEstimateData

JobQueued.description: The job went back to the queue (user retry, or a worker stopped renewing its lease).
JobQueued.title: JobQueued

reason.description: Why the job (re)entered the queue, e.g. retry or lost worker.

ModelReadiness.description: One model a worker can run: installed or not, and why not.
ModelReadiness.title: ModelReadiness

PipelineMode.description:
Which stage implementations a job uses.

- `test`: deterministic test pipeline. Emits small real-format fixture artifacts through
  the real API and event contracts. Never presented as a reconstruction of the input.
- `standard`: real stages (Fast3R on the GPU when the worker has it, else the CPU
  classical-geometry baseline).
PipelineMode.title: PipelineMode

ProcessingProgress.description: Server-side processing phase. Counts are null when the work is not countable.
ProcessingProgress.title: ProcessingProgress

producer.description: Stage adapter that produced the artifact.

test_pipeline.description: True when produced by the deterministic test pipeline, not a real model.

SamplingInfo.description:
Which frames of the video a job uses: chosen at the requested rate (or automatically),
one per time window (the sharpest usable frame), and lowered to the location's frame cap
if needed.

auto.description: True when the frame count was chosen automatically from the video length.

cap.description: Most frames this job's compute location allows.

clamped.description: True when the request needed more frames than the cap.

fps_effective.description: Frames actually used per second of video.

SamplingInfo.title: SamplingInfo

budget_mib.description: The GPU memory budget it ran under (0: unlimited).

peak_vram_mib.description: Peak GPU memory this stage's models used, if any.

StageName.description:
Processing stages. Each value is also the job status while that stage runs.

Moving objects are masked *before* geometry, so the masks keep them out of the pose
estimate as well as out of the points.
StageName.title: StageName

completed.description: Units of real work done. Null when not measurable.

total.description: Total units. Null means indeterminate progress.

budget_mib.description: GPU memory budget it ran under.

reason.description: Why it was skipped or failed.

TelemetrySummary.description: Computed from the normalised track. Times are seconds since the video started.

findings.description: Plain-language notes on limits of this telemetry.

gaps.description: Pauses longer than 1.5 s; never interpolated.

horizontal_extent_m.description: Largest horizontal distance from the first position (via WGS84 ENU).

video_coverage.description: Fraction of the video's duration covered by samples outside gaps.

video_duration_s.description: From the video's preflight; null until the video is validated.

TelemetrySummary.title: TelemetrySummary

TimeModel.description:
A worker's total job time as a straight line in the frame count, so the UI can quote an
estimate before a job exists: `fixed_s + per_frame_s * frames` (no telemetry assumed).
TimeModel.title: TimeModel

VideoProbe.description: Facts read from the container/stream by ffprobe. `display_*` include rotation.
VideoProbe.title: VideoProbe

WorkerEvent.description:
An event reported by the worker. The API assigns `seq`, `ts` and `status`.

`key` makes delivery idempotent: re-sending an event with a key the job already has is a
no-op, so the worker can safely retry after a dropped connection.
WorkerEvent.title: WorkerEvent

lease_id.description: Send as `X-Nazar-Lease` on every call for this job.

telemetry_asset_id.description: Accepted telemetry pinned when the job was created; fetch it from `inputs/telemetry`.

geometry.description: Geometry backend for standard jobs on this worker (absent: not reported).

job_id.description: Lease only this queued job (offline bundle import); absent: oldest first.

location.description: Only jobs aimed at this location are leased.

models.description: Models this worker can run right now (absent: not reported).

time_model.description: How long this worker takes per frame (absent: not reported).

WorkerPresence.description: Whether a worker at this location polled the API recently (presence, not a secret).

geometry.description: Geometry backend it reported for standard jobs (None: not reported).

last_seen_s.description: Seconds since its last call; None: never.

models.description: Models it can run right now (None: not reported).

time_model.description: Its time per frame, for estimates before a job (None: unknown).

WorkerPresence.title: WorkerPresence
